verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is itself an official open-source CLI. It has documented subcommands (`git`, `dir`, `stdin`) with concrete invocation examples, installs via Homebrew, Docker or Go, offers pre-commit hook integration, and writes machine-readable reports such as findings.json, all of which suit scripted or agent-driven use. Missing for 10: agent-oriented documentation (llms.txt returns 404), a full flag and output-format reference in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
